name: Selfnamed: Cosmetics on demand
author: selfnamed

sections.description:
Easily create sets of custom skincare products and link them to your store.

Dropshipp orders received in your WooCommerce by Selfnamed.

Import custom skincare products into your WooCommerce store with one click.

Sync orders back to the Selfnamed.com platform.

Use the Mockup Generator to create custom product labels.

Preview and save your custom product labels.

External services

This plugin uses an external service selfnamed it is needed to handle products sync and orders drop shipping.

The following information is shared with selfnamed when an order containing a selfnamed product is placed:
* Customer address, name and information
* Order products, delivery methods and shipping address

This information is used to perform drop shipping to end-user

The following information is retrieved from selfnamed:
* Product information and Product images

This information is used to create and manage products on the store front

Selfnamed Terms of Services: https://www.selfnamed.com/en/policies/terms-of-service
Selfnamed Privacy Policy: https://www.selfnamed.com/en/policies/privacy-policy
